definitions.explanation: The area running alongside a river; used to describe locations or paths that follow the course of a river.

examples.japanese: {川沿|かわぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I take a walk along the riverside path.

examples.japanese: {川沿|かわぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{川沿|かわぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This hotel is along the river and has a nice view.

examples.japanese: {川沿|かわぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took a break at a café along the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{川沿|かわぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}に→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, many people gather to see the cherry blossoms along the river.

notes:
{川沿|かわぞ}い is a compound: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧ (river) + {沿|そ}い (along). Note the rendaku: そい → ぞい.

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{海沿|うみぞ}い→海沿い：27984_umizoi⟧ (along the coast)
- ⟦{道沿|みちぞ}い→道沿い：noentry⟧ (along the road)
- ⟦{線路沿|せんろぞ}い→線路沿い：noentry⟧ (along the train tracks)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {川沿|かわぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (riverside ~)
- {川沿|かわぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (along the river)

USAGE:
- Often used for describing pleasant walking routes
- Common in real estate descriptions for properties near rivers
